items.title: HCA Healthcare’s (NYSE:HCA) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates
items.summary: Hospital operator HCA Healthcare (NYSE:HCA) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8.7% year on year to $20.23 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $78.25 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $7.62 per share was 2.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
